raw_content: {"internal_thinking":"Bob is trying to play the 'good guy' while literally sitting on my best sheep hex. He just traded away a surplus to Charlie to gain leverage. Charlie is now loaded with wheat but still needs sheep, which I have. I need to make sure Charlie doesn't get too cozy with Bob after that trade. My plan is to remind the table who is actually being aggressive here.","note_to_self":"Bob traded 3 Wheat to Charlie for 1 Wood. Bob likely has 1 Wood and 1 Wheat left. Charlie has 5 Wheat and 1 Wood. Charlie still needs Brick and Sheep. Robber is still on my Hex 4.","say_outloud":"Hard not to look sour when you're the one standing on my sheep, Bob. 'Working together' usually doesn't involve theft."}
